class MinStack:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items = []
        self.mins = []

    def push(self, x):
        self.items.append(x)
        if ...:  # x is at most the current smallest, or there is none yet
            self.mins.append(x)

    def pop(self):
        x = self.items.pop()
        if ...:  # x is the current smallest
            ...
        return x

    def smallest(self):
        return self.mins[-1] if self.mins else None
